## The problem

What are you trying to see or understand about your sessions that AgentReplay doesn't show you today?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen. If it's a new number, say which session fields it comes from: AgentReplay only shows what the logs record.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways to get at the same thing, and why they fall short.

## Scope check

Before filing, please skim the out-of-scope list in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#hard-scope-lines). Hosted versions, accounts, telemetry, model-generated text, leaderboards, and non-Claude-Code session formats are deliberately out of scope — requests for those will be closed with a pointer there.
